scraperConfig.analyzerNotes: This is a Workday-based job board (myworkdayjobs.com domain). The HTML shows only a React root div (#root), indicating the entire page is rendered client-side with JavaScript. Based on typical Workday job board structure, job listings are rendered as list items with data-automation-id attributes. Common selectors include: job cards as 'li[data-automation-id="compositeContainer"]', job titles as 'a[data-automation-id="jobTitle"]', locations as 'dd[data-automation-id="location"]', and posted dates as 'dd[data-automation-id="postedOn"]'. Workday boards typically use infinite scroll pagination. Company name is usually not displayed per job card since it's a single-company career site (Trafigura). Salary information is rarely shown on Workday boards. A 2-second delay is recommended to allow for JavaScript rendering and API calls.
